# 行舟 · 个人项目与事务中心 v0.1.0

这是行舟首个可正式使用和持续测试的版本。它以思源属性视图作为唯一结构化数据源，覆盖“捕获—整理—安排—执行—回顾”的个人项目管理闭环。

## 主要功能

- 使用“全部”页浏览长期领域、项目层级和独立工作项，并按活跃项目、将来和已结束筛选。
- 直接编辑工作项类型、状态、层级关系、计划与截止日期、预计时长和所需精力。
- 点击“本次行动细则”或“下一步行动”即可就地编辑，支持失焦保存、`Esc` 取消和 `Cmd/Ctrl + Enter` 保存。
- 在“收件箱”中只填写名称即可快速捕获，无需为一次性事务建立文档。
- 使用真实日期安排本周事务与想法，查看有效日期窗口提醒，并快速移动、取消安排或完成事项。
- 通过五步“整理”检查收件箱、当前投入方向、行动细则、遗留日期和本周成果。
- 日期只生成“今日”“已逾期”等提示，不会在后台篡改真实进度状态。
- 跟随思源主题和暗黑模式，并可打开关联文档或原生数据库。

## 数据与安全边界

- 思源属性视图是唯一工作项数据源，插件不维护第二份任务副本。
- 只有捕获、编辑、安排、移动日期或完成等用户明确操作才会写入数据库。
- 插件不会自动新增或删除字段、创建项目文档、修复层级关系或改变日期对应的实际状态。

## 安装

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.1.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Projects & Tasks v0.1.0

This is Xingzhou's first complete release for real-world use and continued testing. A native SiYuan Attribute View remains the single source of truth while the plugin covers the capture–review–schedule–execute–reflect loop.

## Highlights

- Browse long-term areas, project hierarchies, and independent items on the All page, with Active Projects, Someday, and Closed filters.
- Directly edit type, lifecycle status, hierarchy relations, plan/deadline dates, duration, and energy.
- Click Current Action or Next Action to edit in place, with blur-to-save, `Esc` cancellation, and `Cmd/Ctrl + Enter` saving.
- Capture name-only Inbox items without creating documents for simple one-off work.
- Schedule executable Transactions and Ideas on actual week dates, see active date-window reminders, and move, unschedule, or complete items quickly.
- Use the five-step Review page for Inbox, current investment directions, action details, stale dates, and this week's results.
- Today and Overdue are derived hints; dates never overwrite actual progress status in the background.
- Follow SiYuan themes and dark mode, and open linked documents or the native database when needed.

## Data and safety boundary

- The native Attribute View is the only work-item data source; Xingzhou stores no second task database.
- Writes happen only after explicit capture, edit, scheduling, date movement, or completion actions.
- Xingzhou never creates or removes fields, creates project documents, repairs hierarchy relations, or changes actual status merely because time passed.

## Installation

Download the attached `package.zip`. Do not use GitHub's automatically generated source-code archives as the SiYuan plugin package.

See [CHANGELOG.en.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v0.1.0/CHANGELOG.en.md) for the complete record.
